description: This file is a CMake module script defining functions and macros for setting up code coverage analysis in a CMake-based build system. It includes functions to configure coverage report generation with tools like lcov and gcovr, and handles inclusion of appropriate compiler flags, exclusion patterns, and report output options.

methods.name: setup_target_for_coverage_lcov
methods.description: Configures a custom build target in CMake to run coverage analysis using lcov, collect coverage data, and generate an HTML report.

methods.name: setup_target_for_coverage_gcovr_xml
methods.description: Sets up a build target to run gcovr and produce an XML coverage report in Cobertura format.

methods.name: setup_target_for_coverage_gcovr_html
methods.description: Sets up a build target to run gcovr and produce an HTML coverage report with detailed coverage information.

methods.name: append_coverage_compiler_flags
methods.description: Appends coverage-related compiler flags to the current compiler flags for C, C++, and Fortran.
